review: The hymn is the beatific vision: 1:1–4 is 1 Cor 13:12 (פָּנִים בְּפָנִים) with 1 Thess 4:17, 2:1–4 is Rev 22:4 with Gal 2:20, 3:1–4 is 1 Pet 1:8 with Rom 13:11, and 4:1–4 is Ps 16:11 with Job 19:27 (מִבְּשָׂרִי אֶחֱזֶה אֱלוֹהַּ).

3:2 אֶתְעַנֵּג בַּדּוֹד — the Arabic فِيهِ أَهْنَا بِالْحَبِيب is 'in whom I delight'; the Hebrew uses עָנַג, the verb of Ps 37:4 and Isa 58:14, so the line is the psalm's delight in the Lord and not merely gladness at a meeting.
4:4 בְּעַיִן בְּעָיִן — the Arabic بِالْعِيَان is 'plainly, visibly'; the Hebrew keeps Job 19:27's double 'eye' construction, because the stanza's whole claim is that this sight is not a figure.
